top_signals.title: Malicious apps prey on Russians’ anxiety about fuel prices, drone strikes
top_signals.summary: Cybercriminals are stuffing infostealer malware into bogus apps aimed at tracking gas prices, police activity, drone strikes and other information of concern to average Russians, researchers said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Ripple strikes deal with Robinhood to expand its RLUSD digital dollar
top_signals.summary: As crypto evolves past its trading roots, and global markets shift to 24/7 liquidity, stablecoins are becoming essential financial infrastructure.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Good AI adoption should force junior lawyers to think harder
top_signals.summary: AI has entered the legal world, but rather than making lawyers lazier, it should force them to think harder, writes Alex Fortescue-Webb.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
